title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Hufanga will return for the first time since Week 5 for Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charlie Kolar (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Kolar returned to a limited practice on Friday. His status remains up in the air heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daiyan Henley (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Daiyan Henley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Henley will be sidelined with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: McConkey was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Likely was unable to practice on Friday. He'll still be good to go on Sunday where he remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Gay (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Matt Gay is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansei Matsuzawa would likely be elevated if Gay is ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (heel) limited in practice Friday
items.desc: Rachaad White was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: White was added to the injury report. He was still able to practice in limited fashion.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Treylon Burks did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Burks will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Carter (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Zach Carter has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Carter has returned to practice. He won't be activated for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jon Gaines II (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jon Gaines II has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Gaines did not practice on Thursday or Friday. He will be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zack Baun (back) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Zack Baun (back) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Baun is going to be sidelined this week while he recovers from a back issue of some kind. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front weaker than usual in a matchup against the Steelers this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Hjalte Froholdt is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Froholdt will be good to go after clearing concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Carson Beck is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Beck is dealing with a back injury. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Wicks has been ruled out for another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from a pair of injuries, and although he seems to be improving, he's not yet where he needs to be to make his return to the lineup. His next chance to play will come on Thanksgiving Day against the Dallas Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat (shoulder/rest) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Josh Sweat is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Sweat returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Walter Nolen III (illness) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Walter Nolen III is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Nolen returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Shipley (foot/illness) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Will Shipley (foot/illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: The team recently opened the 21-day practice window for Shipley, and he may be back in the lineup on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play. His path to play is now more complicated thanks to an illness that he picked up, and fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have a big role even if he's fully cleared to make his return this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Smith will be back in the lineup on Sunday after missing some time with a hamstring injury. His presence should be a nice boost for Philadelphia's offense moving forward, but he himself will likely be an inconsistent fantasy option with Joe Milton III currently the starting quarterback for the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Carnell Tate is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Cowboys.
items.impact: Tate was able to practice all week, including a full practice on Friday. He is trending towards returning on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran wideout will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Jacksonville's injury report throughout the week with an ankle issue. Meyers will continue to play his usual role in Week 11 and beyond.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Spears finished the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Antonio Johnson (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Antonio Johnson (ankle) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Johnson is without an injury designation heading into the weekend, meaning his ankle injury isn't much more than a minor issue at this point. He will continue to play a key role in Jacksonville's secondary moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) will play Sunday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Allen is going to be available to play on Sunday, which shouldn't come as a surprise to fantasy managers. He won't see enough work to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Rodriguez is set to play on Sunday, despite managing a hand issue at practice throughout the week. He will continue to play second fiddle in this backfield behind Bhayshul Tuten for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Hill Jr. (neck) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Anthony Hill Jr. has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Hill was able to get in practices all week, including a full practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Carmona Jr. (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Fernando Carmona Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Carmona was designated to return to practice. He will not be activated this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody Barton (concussion) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Cody Barton is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Barton was able to clear concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Adams (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Tony Adams is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Adams remains in concussion protocol. He got in a full practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Tuten will be good to go for Sunday's game, despite missing some practice this week due to a couple of nagging lower-body issues. He should be a full go against the Giants and will remain a high-quality fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jay Ward listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jay Ward is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Ward will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Rodgers will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Addison remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Murray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Murray remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson is off the injury report for Sunday against the 49ers.
items.impact: Hockenson was able to return to practice all week. He'll be a low-end TE1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Booker (ankle) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Booker (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: The Cowboys will be without Booker on Sunday, as he's currently recovering from an ankle issue of some kind. Their offensive front will be a bit weaker with him out of the lineup for this game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle/foot) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle/foot) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: As expected, Porter will be available to play on Sunday, despite still managing two minor injuries. His presence will continue to be important for a struggling Dallas defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DaRon Bland (ankle) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: DaRon Bland (ankle) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Bland is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He recently suffered an ankle injury and is going to miss some time as a result, although it's unclear if he will miss more time beyond this game. Dallas' already-weak secondary will be operating at less than full strength with him out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker (illness) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Luke Schoonmaker (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Schoonmaker is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's currently recovering from an illness of some kind and is likely considered day-to-day as a result. Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) has already been ruled out for Sunday, Brevyn Spann-Ford will be primed for a lot of work if Schoonmaker is also unavailable to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: To no surprise, Ferguson will be sidelined for a second-straight game after suffering a couple of different injuries in a recent game. It remains to be seen if he will be back in the lineup in Week 12 or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) won't play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: The Cowboys will be without Mingo on Sunday, as he is going to be sidelined due to an ankle injury that left him sidelined at practice all week. Ryan Flournoy will see more opportunities while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Bowers is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is going to be questionable to play on Sunday as a result, according to HC Klint Kubiak. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health heading into the weekend, as he will remain a must-start fantasy option if active, even if he's not playing at less than full strength.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, as his shoulder injury isn't considered to be anything more than a minor issue at this point. He has week-to-week fantasy upside, but his weekly floor is also somewhat low with how bad Miami's offense has looked lately.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Brewer (concussion) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Brewer (concussion) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Brewer is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and is questionable to be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game. He was able to log a full practice session on Friday, however, which indicates that he's trending in the right direction currently.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: JuJu Brents (neck) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: JuJu Brents (neck) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Brents will be available to play on Sunday. His neck injury isn't a serious issue at this point and won't affect his availability for this game against the Bills, which is good news for Miami's secondary in what projects to be a tough matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: The rookie is not listed on the team's injury report heading into the weekend, meaning that he will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bills. He's still not expected to be a reliable fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Ray Davis (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Davis was limited at multiple practices earlier in the week due to a hamstring issue, but he was able to practice in full on Friday and is off of the injury report entirely heading into the weekend. He will play and see his usual limited workload against Miami this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Damar Hamlin (toe) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Damar Hamlin (toe) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Hamlin finds himself on Buffalo's injury report due to a toe issue. He's uncertain to play on Sunday, and Buffalo's secondary will be operating at less than full strength if he's sidelined for that matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jackson Hawes (shoulder) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jackson Hawes (shoulder) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Hawes is uncertain to play on Sunday thanks to a shoulder injury that he's managing. His absence would be less than ideal for the Bills this week with Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) currently doubtful to suit up.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dee Alford (concussion) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Dee Alford (concussion) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Alford missed practice earlier in the week while going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he has since been cleared and is going to be available to play on Sunday. He will be more important for the Bills this week with Christian Benford (groin) and Damar Hamlin (toe) both set to be sidelined.
